role: Root-released mechanical own-original D15+D1 serialization; no independent science by technical role

ownRationaleParts: Die Beschreibung verlangt biotechnologische Herstellung samt Aufarbeitung und begrenztem Produktnachweis. Sie setzt Gasbildung oder Filtrat ausdrücklich nicht mit einem reinen Zielstoff gleich. Der Gesamtprozess ist eine kohärente Herstellungsleistung.

Active biological material transforms suitable substrates; a worked-up preparation is neither a pure substance nor fully identified by gas evolution. The bilingual description preserves this competence, and the illustrative cases do not become compulsory methods.

Reaktionsgleichung, Stoffmengen und Aufarbeitung begründen eine chemische Präparation. Die klare Trennung von Produktmasse, Ausbeute und Reinheitsgrenzen ist fachlich nötig und innerhalb derselben Präparationskompetenz beobachtbar.

The limiting reactant bounds theoretical product mass; recovered mass, corrected yield and purity are different quantities. The bilingual description preserves this competence, and the illustrative cases do not become compulsory methods.

Die Auswahl des Präparats, mikroskopische Untersuchung und beobachtungsgebundene Zeichnung sind Teile eines zusammenhängenden mikroskopischen Arbeitsgangs. Die Probenarten sind Alternativen, keine Pflicht zu unabhängig allen aufgeführten Gegenständen.

Preparation and optical conditions determine what is visible and measurable; a drawing must correctly represent observations, scale and artefact limits. The bilingual description preserves this competence, and the illustrative cases do not become compulsory methods.

Die Beschreibung bindet das Ergebnis an eine prüfbare biologische Anforderung, tatsächlichen kontrollierten Versuch, Originalbeobachtungen und begrenzte Geltung. Sie verlangt noch kein standortbezogenes Eignungsurteil des nachfolgenden ökologischen Ziels.

A basic requirement is investigated under defined conditions; water supply, oxygen availability, salinity and biological variation must not be confounded unnoticed. The bilingual description preserves this competence, and the illustrative cases do not become compulsory methods.

Die Beschreibung fokussiert einen Einfluss auf eine Enzymreaktion und trennt Wirkung, Störgrößen sowie Schlussgrenzen. Das ist vom allgemeinen Organismenversuch und der Reizantwort unterscheidbar; der Theorie-Vorgänger zu Enzymfaktoren passt zur praktischen Vertiefung.

A change in catalase-associated reaction must be tested against background and conditions; crude extract and ordinal bubbling do not establish purified-enzyme kinetics. The bilingual description preserves this competence, and the illustrative cases do not become compulsory methods.

Die Beschreibung präzisiert Reiz, Scheinbehandlung, zeitgebundene Beobachtung und die Grenze zur nicht gemessenen Zellursache. Dies beschreibt eine einzige kontrollierte Reizantwortuntersuchung und setzt keinen Erfolg bei jeder Pflanze voraus.

An observable stimulus response needs a suitable sham comparison; plant replicates, leaflet pairs and time points are different observation units. The bilingual description preserves this competence, and the illustrative cases do not become compulsory methods.

Praktisches Einsetzen und biologisch-chemisches Erklären betreffen denselben Lebensmittelprozess. Die Beschreibung ist methodenoffen und entspricht der einschlägigen BcP-Quellkompetenz; sie behauptet keine Verzehr- oder Produktsicherheit.

Food preparation connects biological conversion with chemical or physical structural changes; volume, pH and consistency each support limited claims. The bilingual description preserves this competence, and the illustrative cases do not become compulsory methods.

Die Beschreibung nennt Arznei- oder Körperpflege als alternative Produktbereiche und verlangt Herstellung plus chemische Erklärung desselben Prozesses. Physikalische Präparation bleibt möglich; medizinische Wirkung oder Körperverträglichkeit wird nicht behauptet.

Composition, interfaces and phase changes explain a preparation; making a model product establishes neither synthesis of a new substance nor bodily compatibility. The bilingual description preserves this competence, and the illustrative cases do not become compulsory methods.

Herstellen, vergleichbar prüfen und daraus eine Verwendung begründen bilden einen zusammenhängenden Materialentwicklungsprozess. Die Beschreibung verlangt keine allgemeine Bauzulassung und lässt unterschiedliche Werkstoffe zu.

Material recipe and structure affect properties; only criteria measured under comparable conditions support a particular application. The bilingual description preserves this competence, and the illustrative cases do not become compulsory methods.

Das Ziel verlangt Materialkombination als funktionelles System und die Begründung der Anwendung. Es unterscheidet sich von der Herstellung einzelner Werkstoffe durch das Zusammenspiel und die Schnittstellen; der Material-Vorgänger ist dafür didaktisch nachvollziehbar.

System function arises from coordinated material roles and interfaces; one favourable observation does not establish overall application suitability. The bilingual description preserves this competence, and the illustrative cases do not become compulsory methods.

Merkmale, passende Literatur, dokumentierter Schlüsselweg und begrenzte Auflösung machen die Bestimmung prüfbar. Die Bedingung unzureichender Merkmale schützt vor erfundenen Artnamen, ohne eine begründbare Artbestimmung auszuschließen.

A taxonomic assignment follows from actually observed discriminating traits and suitable literature; missing traits limit achievable resolution. The bilingual description preserves this competence, and the illustrative cases do not become compulsory methods.

Das Ziel beschreibt eine eigene ökologische Freilandaufnahme einschließlich Gemeinschaft und Standort. Der ausdrücklich begrenzte Korrelationsschluss trennt diese Kompetenz von manipulativer Wirkungsprüfung und Eignungsurteil.

Comparable sampling describes community and site; cover, area density, relative sensor indices and causal effect are different claims. The bilingual description preserves this competence, and the illustrative cases do not become compulsory methods.

Die Beschreibung verlangt eine tatsächliche ökologische Wirkungsprüfung und verbindet sie mit Feldbedingungen zu einem begrenzten Eignungsargument. Das ist eine zusammenhängende kausale Transferleistung und nicht die bloße Wiederholung des vorausgesetzten Grundversuchs.

A site judgement needs an evidenced connection between original controlled effects and field conditions for the tested species, life stage and outcome; missing comparability can require an unresolved decision. The bilingual description preserves this competence, and the illustrative cases do not become compulsory methods.

Komponentenbestimmung, Mengenanteile und Bilanz gehören zu einer zusammenhängenden Gemischanalyse. Die Beschreibung trennt diese Kompetenz von der Identifizierung eines unbekannten Reinstoffs und begrenzt den Schluss durch Bilanz und Unsicherheit.

Material properties justify the analysis; recovered fractions, original composition and unassigned losses are different claims. The bilingual description preserves this competence, and the illustrative cases do not become compulsory methods.

Der begründete Kandidatenraum macht Identität prüfbar; Referenzen und offen zu legende Mehrdeutigkeit verhindern eine unbegrenzte Identitäts- oder Reinheitsbehauptung. Auswahl und sichere eigene Durchführung bilden einen einzelnen analytischen Entscheidungsweg.

Identity is supported by discriminating evidence within a justified candidate set; conductivity or elemental detection alone is not universal substance identification or purity measurement. The bilingual description preserves this competence, and the illustrative cases do not become compulsory methods.
LB4: biotechnological production with safe documented preparation and work-up.
Production route, biological controls, obtained preparation and product-identification limits form a coherent practical outcome. English work it up preserves aufarbeiten.
Active/inactive yeast and the starch variant support a prospective controlled manufacture/work-up assessment. Gas volume and filtration do not prove ethanol, gas identity or purity.
Matched active/inactive flasks and filtration with an unresolved dissolved mixture orient the learner. Actual original practical records remain necessary.
Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.
LB4: chemical preparation, work-up, documented purity and yield considerations.
Reaction equation and quantities support practical planning; product mass, yield and purity limits are explicitly distinguished in equivalent DE/EN.
Calcium-carbonate batches and the explicitly referenced concentration change make the outcome assessable. Theoretical mass, gross mass yield and purity-corrected yield remain different statements.
Planning, collection/washing and an unquantified product question fit the scope. Equation/molar-mass prerequisites support the balance; the picture is not execution evidence.
Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.
LB5: select specimen preparation/microscopy, examine biological or material samples, document and draw observed structures.

The specimen types are alternatives within one microscopy workflow, not separate mandatory certifications. Both descriptions preserve selection, safe examination, characteristic observations, labelled drawing and documentation.

Whole onion/starch cases require actual preparation/focusing and original drawings. Unseen nuclei, granule-to-cell identification and an uncalibrated scale must not be invented; a folded specimen or magnification change exposes the method limit.
The workflow illustration is a specimen/drawing example, not an observed onion/starch record or an independently calibrated learner drawing. Actual Native wording is complete and readable.
Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.
LB6: hypothesis-led organism-requirements investigations with safety and species/nature protection.
Controlled investigation, original conditions/observations and bounded inference define one practical performance in equivalent DE/EN.
Dry/moist cress and new salinity conditions expose control and water-accounting decisions. Nominal start salinity is not continuously proven constant concentration or a universal plant threshold.
Bean germination is a schematic life-stage sequence; light is explicitly assigned to later growth. It is not a cress dataset or controlled investigation result.
Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.
LB6: investigate influences on enzyme reactions, with LB1 controlled-method/documentation context.
The description requires a factor hypothesis, controlled original observations and discrimination of action, confounders and limits. Describing an optimum curve alone cannot satisfy it.
Cooled heat-pretreated crude extract and fresh extract-amount comparisons expose different factors. Ordinal bubbling cannot supply oxygen amounts, purified-enzyme kinetics or a universal optimum.
Different-enzyme pH curves are a model example rather than catalase measurements. The conceptual enzyme-factor prerequisite remains separate from the practical outcome.
Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.
LB6: investigate observable organism stimulus responsiveness safely and protect organisms.
Defined stimulus, sham, scoring/time rule and separation from an unmeasured cellular cause make the response claim observable and bounded in DE/EN.
The whole Mimosa design retains separate main/transfer plants, original N/C/U records, plant-level replication and null/uncertain outcomes. Its arithmetic example is constructed.
Gentle touch versus no touch asks for observation/comparison without asserting numerical response, pain, learning or a particular cellular mechanism.
Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.
LB4: practically apply selected everyday food techniques and explain biological and chemical foundations.
Applying a technique and explaining its foundations form one source-backed practical competence. Neither language demands every suggested technique or an entire food-technology curriculum.
Whole dough and defined-starter milk cases require original manufacture and link gas retention or acid/protein behaviour to biology/chemistry. Appearance, pH or rise alone do not prove food safety.
The broad overview is orienting. Recipes, hygiene, controls and original execution must come from the full cases and chosen actual materials.
Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.
LB4: produce selected pharmaceutical OR personal-care products and explain manufacture.
The description retains the source alternative and does not require both categories, drug synthesis, medical efficacy or skin-safety proof. DE/EN preserve the same practical explanatory outcome.
Whole cream/balm cases are valid personal-care alternatives. Manufacture and interface/phase reasoning do not establish shelf life, compatibility or a new chemical synthesis.
The oil-in-water emulsion is one illustration. Its warm-process picture is not the cold-process protocol; the selected actual recipe and supervision remain controlling.
Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.
LB4: manufacture materials, compare properties under matched conditions and justify application.
Manufacture, comparable property testing and conditional use judgement form one material-evaluation outcome, assessable in both languages.

Whole plaster/film cases connect original preparation with setting, geometry and plasticiser effects. School fracture loads do not provide structural certification; bendability is not tensile strength.
Concrete is an orienting example, not a replacement for original plaster/film records. The successor system-combination goal requires its own assembled system and performance.
Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.
LB4: combine selected construction/engineering materials into functional systems and justify uses.
Actual combination and application reasoning are distinct from producing/testing one material. DE/EN identify the same coherent system outcome.

Whole model-wall/filter cases expose component roles, interfaces and original comparative tests. Clarity is not potability/salt removal, and transient temperature is not full conductivity measurement.
Load/material illustrations suggest coordinated component roles without prescribing a pupil bridge or granting structural approval. The material-testing prerequisite is coherent.
Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.
LB7: use identification literature, including field identification.
Observation, suitable literature, documented route and a justified group/uncertainty result remain one identification outcome. Missing diagnostic traits do not license invented species names.
Lawn/pond observations and new specimens require fresh verified traits and a matching literature/key route. A supplied grouping key or taxon name does not replace that performance.
The meadow illustration is a schematic identification situation, not confirmed species inventory. Identification sensibly precedes community surveying; neither confers mastery of the other.
Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.
LB7: hypothesis-led field characterisation of communities and abiotic factors qualitatively and quantitatively.
Sampling, community/site records and association-versus-causation limits define one field-survey outcome. Both languages preserve actual field work and original sampling.

Lawn, pond and new post-weather-change sampling require original field records. Cover, density, taxonomic groups and relative moisture index remain distinct; observation alone does not isolate one cause.

The full Native title and description wrap readably. The quadrat illustration is orienting. A separate 360px Runtime title/icon overlap is recorded as an open presentation REVISION, with no canonical wording change.
Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.
LB7: actually conduct ecological laboratory/manipulative field testing and use effects for habitat-suitability assessment.

The long description still identifies one integrated judgement: original effect data connected to documented field conditions. Species, life stage, outcome, uncertainty and possible non-decision constrain the claim in both languages.
Cress and duckweed cases require actual controlled effect data plus an evidence table connecting site conditions and transfer limits. Repeating 07bf alone does not establish the habitat judgement.

The whole Native page is readable. The explicitly schematic lizard/site picture establishes neither suitability, a single cause nor an executed effect test. Basic organism-requirements investigation is a defensible foundation.
Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.
LB3: qualitative and quantitative mixture composition with safe documented analysis.
Component discrimination and quantities within a transparent balance form one analytical outcome. Both languages retain selection, actual performance, documentation and inference limits.
Iron/NaCl/sand provides complete prospective analysis; the NaCl/sucrose variant keeps unseparated shares unresolved. Recovery is not purity or identity of missing mass.
Generic preparation/analysis/evaluation imagery is orientation only. It gives no measured amounts or identity proof. Data-validity, documentation and safety prerequisites fit the analytical claim.
Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.
LB3: choose and safely perform analyses to identify unknown pure substances.
A justified candidate set, discriminating methods, references and disclosed ambiguity make identification assessable and equivalent in DE/EN.

Solubility/conductivity and the Na/K extension expose the need for another selective method after expanding the candidate set. The enclosed emission station is an explicit feasibility condition; no execution is claimed.
The shared analysis montage cannot identify an unknown or establish its purity. Current safety/data-validity foundations are distinct from the required identification performance.
Separate selected Bavarian BcP12/13; no nationwide ordinary Chemistry GK/LK duty inferred.

Die unveränderte Beschreibung ist auch mit den neuen konkreten Voraussetzungen fachlich tragfähig. Angeleitete sichere Untersuchung, Kennzeichnungsverständnis, begründeter Umgang und Entsorgung, Risikoreduktion sowie nachvollziehbare Dokumentation liefern die notwendige praktische Grundlage. Die eigentliche Auswahl, Durchführung und Prüfung des Isolierungs-/Reinigungsverfahrens wird weiterhin in diesem Ziel gelernt und muss nicht schon im bisherigen breiten Laborcluster als gemeistert vorausgesetzt werden. Stoffeigenschaft, Verfahrenswahl, tatsächliche Gewinnung, Reinheitsprüfung und begründete Ausbeute bilden einen zusammenhängenden präparativen Arbeitsgang; eine bloß höhere rückgewonnene Masse beweist keine höhere Reinheit. Die neue Vorgängerstruktur erweitert weder die Beschreibung noch ihre Methoden. Dies ist eine gezielte Revalidierung der aktuellen D1-Bindung, keine erneute Gesamtfreigabe von Quelle, Graph, Profil oder Bild.

The unchanged description remains scientifically defensible with the concrete new prerequisites. Guided safe investigation, interpreting hazard labels, justified handling and disposal, risk reduction and transparent documentation supply the practical foundation. Selecting, performing and checking the isolation/purification procedure remain learning within this goal and need not already have been mastered through the former broad laboratory cluster. Material property, method choice, actual recovery, purity testing and justified yield form one coherent preparative workflow; a greater recovered mass does not establish greater purity. The new predecessor structure neither expands the description nor prescribes its methods. This is targeted revalidation of the current D1 binding, not a renewed general approval of source, graph, profile or image.

Die tatsächlich gesichtete neue Einzelseite enthält die vollständige unveränderte e7-Beschreibung und Lernziel-ID. Die Kapitelrolle bleibt Labor-/Präparationsverfahren. Die fünf fachlich bereits eigenständig bewerteten Voraussetzungen sind hier sämtlich als Voraussetzungen außerhalb dieses Einzelseitenbuchs aufgeführt; ihre fachliche Bedeutung und die kanonischen Requires sind unverändert. Die Neunerseite führte vier davon als direkte interne Verweise und den Umgang-/Entsorgungscluster extern. Neue Seitennummer, Buchumfang, Verweisplatzierung und Fingerprints ändern hier den prüfbaren Zielgegenstand nicht. Der Text bleibt vollständig lesbar und weder um eine fremde Kompetenz erweitert noch um eigene Durchführung, Reinheitsprüfung, Ausbeute oder Dokumentation verkürzt. Deshalb gilt mein echtes e7-KEEP mit den sechs ursprünglichen Evidenzfeldern unverändert auch für diese konkrete D1-Seite. Diese Aussage beruht auf eigener tatsächlicher Seitenlektüre, nicht auf einer Hash-Ersetzung.

The personally viewed new single-goal page contains the complete unchanged e7 description and goal ID. Its chapter role remains laboratory/preparative procedures. All five prerequisites already independently assessed are now listed outside this single-page book; their scientific meaning and canonical requires are unchanged. The nine-goal page displayed four as internal references and the handling/disposal cluster externally. The new page number, book extent, reference placement and fingerprints do not change the assessable competence here. The text remains fully readable and neither adds another competence nor removes personal performance, purity testing, yield or documentation. My genuine e7 keep decision and six original evidence fields therefore apply unchanged to this exact D1 page. This conclusion follows personal reading of the actual page rather than replacement of a hash.

The official BcP12/13 LB2 asks learners to select isolation methods from physical/chemical substance properties, perform them safely, check purity and yield and document the activity. The unchanged DE/EN descriptions preserve this complete practical outcome. It is not satisfied by analysis-only or synthesis-only child performance.

The actual five direct foundations are guided safe investigation, hazard-label interpretation, chemical handling/disposal, risk reduction and transparent data documentation. They supply practical safety, record keeping and method-execution foundations without already mastering isolation, purity or yield. The current laboratory/preparation parent has no extra requires; removing broad sibling-dependent sequencing does not delete the five concrete foundations.

The text remains sufficiently specific for a selected supervised isolation/purification task and its changed-condition application. Reinheit pruefen requires a justified suitable check with limits, not an absolute purity guarantee; Ausbeute is a recovery/theoretical-reference judgement, not proof of purity. DE/EN preserve that distinction.

The personally inspected current Native whole page shows the exact description, current five prerequisite destinations and separate final-assessment reverse link without clipping. Its schematic workflow, melting-point sketch and yield formula are orienting; a sharp drawn peak or drawn mass ratio is not actual purity/yield evidence.

This targeted D revalidation does not approve a universal source/course obligation, the terminal-assessment prerequisite set, runtime selection or practical execution. BcP remains a separately selected Bavarian course, and other jurisdiction mappings need their own source evidence.

I personally viewed the exact new single-goal PDF-page export. Its complete unchanged description, full goal ID, figure and laboratory/preparation path are readable. The same five canonical prerequisites now appear as external destinations, with no prerequisite omitted or invented; the terminal reverse link is separate. This page organisation does not change my own earlier source-bounded isolation/purification judgement or the distinction between actual performance and the schematic purity/yield picture. The unchanged whole DE/EN description therefore still carries KEEP for this precise one-goal page context. The terminal link does not obtain course-allocation clearance from this amendment.
